title: Space used by the increment machine
statement: Let $k\ge 0$, choose a work-tape index $i<k$, a family of Boolean words $w=(w_j)_{j<k}$, and a time $t\in\mathbb N$. For the increment machine on any Boolean input, the number of cells visited on tape $i$ by time $t$ is at most $|w_i|+2$, while every other tape $j\ne i$ has visited exactly one cell.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes $k$
A family of Boolean words indexed by the tapes
